svg.title: EchoSight: echoes support patches, not complete rooms
svg.desc: One actual synthetic recording response with all 4,225 samples and five candidate echo delays. Twelve surveyed synthetic views yield six partial reflection-support hulls; five views remain ambiguous with no accepted patches. Neither plot establishes physical room accuracy.
svg.text: Echoes support patches. Not complete rooms.
Support hulls are not physical wall edges.
Five views remain ambiguous; twelve views yield six partial support patches.
The first five WAVs are identical. This is one controlled synthetic case, not a physical accuracy study.
Original recordings stay intact across archive export and reprocessing. Published measured ultrasound remains a separate route.
